source: CRON 20261120_0440: bare alias and resolved statement unified from the same company's two copies. Period union taken; a blank rendered cell was filled from the alias only where the alias carried the value and its figures run at the same scale (unit guard). The resolved file's own value wins wherever the two disagreed, and every such disagreement is recorded in _alias_sync_20261120_0440.json. | Mubasher (english.mubasher.info) EGX financial statements summary, annual section; figures published in EGP thousands, stored in absolute EGP. | CRON 20261116: EPS row added from the EGX company disclosures compiled by Starta Markets (startamarkets.com/symbol/TOUR/revenue, read 16 Nov 2026), which prints basic loss per share of EGP 2.79 for 2016 and EGP 2.86 for 2015. The figures tie to this file's own Net Profit: -18,206,751 / -2.79 and -18,618,071 / -2.86 both imply 6.52 million shares, one share count across both years. | CRON 20261116 (later run, same day): the Revenue row written earlier today was REMOVED. Starta prints revenue of 8.19m for 2016 against the 9,777,054 gross profit already stored here, so cost of sales would have to be negative 1.59m, which no trading statement reports, and the same source prints NEGATIVE revenue for 2013 (-3.27m) and 2014 (-3.55m), so its revenue series is not usable for this issuer. The arithmetic gate (gross profit cannot exceed revenue) fails, so the figure is withheld rather than shown. Net Profit, Gross Profit and EPS remain as printed by the summary source.
source_note: Annual income summary from the Mubasher English EGX statement page. Mubasher publishes only Gross Profit and Net Income or Loss for this issuer, so the revenue and cost lines stay empty rather than being guessed. Ratios are computed from this issuer own balance sheet and net profit.

blockage.reason: Only the Gross Profit and Net Profit lines were ever collected for this issuer, from a provider summary that is no longer served. Re-tested 20 Nov 2026: the provider’s EGX section now redirects to its Saudi market site, the exchange filing PDFs at egx.com.eg/downloads reset the connection from this host, and the aggregators that still answer publish revenue on a different definition from the filing, so the missing lines cannot be re-collected from a source that agrees with the issuer.
